verdict.rationale: Scribe's API documents an enable_logging=false option that puts a request in zero retention mode. If data is not retained, it effectively cannot be used for model training. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions training use or a training opt-out policy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that customer audio/transcripts are excluded from model training, an account-level training opt-out control, details on plan eligibility for zero retention, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: When enable_logging is set to false zero retention mode will be used for the request.
